node_definition.done_when: reckon.crew.recovery.dispatch_repair_for_run counts the automatic repair rounds it has opened for a reviewed run (resume or dispatch), durably on that run's pointer and across review rounds, independent of the round id. Once one round has been opened, a later review round of the same run (a new head reviewed after the repair) opens no repair. It records repair_dispatch status handed-to-coordinator, with a reason naming the earlier round, its attempts and the new review's score, and resumes or dispatches nothing. The within-round retry for a resumed turn that ended unanswered (at most two resumes in that first round) is unchanged. Field case: r-20260930T183005741612-a-served-thread-leaves-no-memo-behind was resumed on reviews scoring 82, 83 and 83, each with 0 added failures, because every new head drew a new review and a new round. A new tests/test_one_automatic_repair_round_per_run.py, with resume and dispatch stubbed, covers: the first round resumes; a second round on a new head hands back and resumes nothing; the in-round retry still works in round one. tests/test_the_reflex_resumes_an_unpromoted_run.py and tests/test_reflex_dispatches_one_repair.py still pass. Only the named test files are run, with no call reaching SLURM and no real worker launched, each log ending with an EXIT= line; the coordinator runs the wider population at merge. Before status complete, delete every directory you created under /tmp, print what you delete, and list it in artifacts.
